title: One retrieval platform for many business units instead of many proofs of concept
summary: A healthcare organisation's machine-learning lead (the organisation reportedly employs more than 300,000 people) describes a unified retrieval-augmented knowledge platform for semantic search across many sources; no user or adoption count is visible, and organisational as well as technical hurdles are named.
publishedAt: Data + AI Summit 2024 (session day not verified)
